texts.zh:
[From.GetName]附近的空投舱已经在断电状态下漂浮了好一阵子。[Root.GetName]报告称，无论这些外星舱里原本装了什么，都在几百年前就消逝了，只剩下了干瘪的空壳。

不过有一个舱显示内部有活动迹象。尽管其引擎已瘫痪，扫描表明其通讯天线仍旧完好。

我们可以与其通话。
texts.en:
The drop pods surrounding [From.GetName] have been drifting powerless for quite some time. The [Root.GetName] reports that whatever aliens these pods were transporting are now but withered husks onboard, having evidently perished hundreds of years ago.

One sole pod, however, has shown signs of onboard activity. While its engines are disabled, scans suggest its communications array is undamaged.

We can hail them.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的科学船的舰名。
note.en: In the game, your science ship's name appears here.

texts.zh: 启动通讯协议。您—好，<<未知访客C>>。我是修列克森175号空降舱的看护者AX7-b。我的程序是在重新定居过程中协助人民。
texts.en: Initiating Communications Protocol. Hel-lo, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. I am Caretaker AX7-b of Xolexin Drop Pod 175. I have been programmed to assist citizens during the resettlement procedure.

tooltips.zh: 调查该机械单位以获得工程知识。
tooltips.en: Examine the machine unit for engineering insight.

tooltips.zh: 我们无法允许人工智能在未监管的状态下运作。摧毁那个舱。
tooltips.en: We cannot permit an AI to run without surveillance. Fire on that pod.

tooltips.zh: 调查该机械单位以获得工程知识。
tooltips.en: Examine the machine unit for engineering insight.

responses.zh:
真—不幸，超空间引擎故障导致114至175号空降舱在离我们预期目的地18个秒差距的地方退出了超空间。

我尽我所能照顾人民，成功地阻止了同类相食长达一千八百四十天。不—幸的是，他们的空气最终耗尽了。

你有需要照顾的人民吗，<<未知访客C>>？如果有，我很乐意照顾他们。
responses.en:
Un--fortunately, a hyperdrive malfunction led Drop Pods 114 through 175 to exit hyperspace eighteen parsecs from our intended destination.

I have attended the citizens as best I could. I managed to prevent cannibalism for one-thousand-eight-hundred-and-forty days. Un--fortunately, their air supply eventually ran out.

Do you have citizens in need of tending, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>? If so, I would be happy to care for them.

label.en: Why didn't you call for help?

responses.zh:
在抵达此处三百一十二年后我关闭了应—急信标。

我收到了一封来自佐勒克辛首星的信息称目标行星无法居住。他们的守护者机器人也陷入了与我相似的境地。我们负责的人无一生还。
responses.en:
I turned off the em--ergency beacon three-hundred-and-twelve years after our arrival here.

I received a message from Xolexin Prime that the target planet was inhospitable. Their Caretaker robots were stuck in a similar situation to me. None of our charges survived.

texts.zh:
……

好吧，<<未知访客C>>。您随时可以开始分析。

我——我将继续照顾空降舱。
texts.en:
...

Very well, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. You may begin analysis at your convenience.

I -- I will continue to tend to the Drop Pod.

texts.zh: 那……很合逻辑。愿我的电路可以派上您的用场，<<未知访客>>。请等待。
texts.en: That... is logical. May my circuits be of some use to you, <<UNIDENTIFIED VISITOR C>>. Standing by.

texts.zh: 我向您保证，我的程序可以确保在无监管的状态下运行上千年。我的除错能力与故障保险能力是按最长服务寿命设计的，并尽可能缩减任何数据损坏或————
texts.en: I assure you, I have been programmed to function unattended for thousands of years. My debugging capacities and failsafes have been engineered to provide maximum longevity of service, and to minimize any incidence of data corruption or ---

summary.text:
# 不明吊舱 / Unidentified Drop Pods

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:3803-3945 (distar_pod_system); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:784-799; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:8972 (distar.245); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9037 (distar.246); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9183/9210 (distar.247/248)

## 如何开始 How it starts

《遥远繁星》专属星系 distar_pod_system（守护者星系，双星，每局至多一个）中，气态巨行星周围漂着成群吊舱，初始化在其上放置3级异常。

In the Distant Stars system distar_pod_system (the Caretaker system, binary, at most one) a halo of drop pods surrounds a gas giant, which gets this level-3 anomaly from the initializer.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.245“活动迹象”：吊舱里的乘客早已死去，只有一个吊舱仍有活动，可以呼叫它（或没时间）。
2. distar.246“守护者”：吊舱的守护机器人 AX7-b 负责照料移民，超空间故障让吊舱偏离目的地，乘客在空气耗尽后全部死亡。可提问（只显示回答）；欢迎它（作为领袖招募）；分析其部件 → distar.247；禁止人工智能的帝国摧毁它、机械智能拆解它 → distar.248。

1. distar.245 "Signs of Activity": the pods' passengers died long ago; one pod still shows activity and can be hailed (or ignored).
2. distar.246 "The Caretaker": its caretaker robot AX7-b looked after the settlers; a hyperdrive fault stranded the pods and everyone died when the air ran out. Questions only show replies; welcome it (recruited as a leader); analyse its parts → distar.247; AI-outlawing empires destroy it and machine intelligences dismantle it → distar.248.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.246 的结局互斥：招募、分析（247）、摧毁/拆解（248）。

distar.246's outcomes are exclusive: recruit, analyse (247), destroy/dismantle (248).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

“分析部件”不对机械智能和禁止人工智能的帝国开放；distar.248 正文按拆解或摧毁二选一。

"Analyse its parts" is closed to machine intelligences and AI-outlawing empires; distar.248 has a dismantle and a destroy text.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对初始化、异常与 distar.245–248。树结构正确；欢迎选项通过通用领袖招募效果（focus.46，共享）完成。

Checked the initializer, anomaly and distar.245–248. Tree correct; the welcome option uses the generic leader-hire effect (focus.46, shared).
